MINUTES
  SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, JULY 28, 2025 AT 8:00 A.M.
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS

CALL TO ORDER: Trustee Domier called the special meeting to order at 8:01 a.m. in the City
Hall Council Chambers, located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Trustee Domier led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Alternate Peck, Trustee Chien, Trustee Domier, Trustee Milkie
  Nixon

  ABSENT: Alternate Nichols, Trustee Wahl, Trustee Wu

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

1. CHAIR REPORT

This report was skipped as the Chair role is currently vacant.

2. TRUSTEE REPORTS

No reports were given at this time.

3. CRAIN ART GALLERY LIAISON REPORT

Staff gave a report as this liaison role is currently vacant.

4. FRIENDS OF THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Domier gave a report.

5. SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Chien gave a report.

NEW BUSINESS

6. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Trustee Milkie Nixon moved, seconded by Trustee Chien, to approve the minutes of the special
meeting of May 12, 2025.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Alternate Peck, Trustee Chien, Trustee Domier, Trustee Milkie Nixon
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Alternate Nichols, Trustee Wahl, Trustee Wu

7. DIRECTOR AND LIBRARY MANAGER REPORT

Director Johnson presented the staff report.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

8. APPROVAL OF FINAL UPDATES TO THE COLLECTION DEVELOPMENT
  POLICY

Director Johnson and Youth Services Librarian Torres presented the staff report.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Trustee Chien moved, seconded by Trustee Milkie Nixon, to approve of the updates to the
Collection Development Policy.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Alternate Peck, Trustee Chien, Trustee Domier, Trustee Milkie Nixon
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Alternate Nichols, Trustee Wahl, Trustee Wu

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

The following person(s) provided written communications or public writings:
  - None
